summary: Inter-se seniority of absorbed vs original employees in DME; dual control abolition policy; Rule 27(a)/27(c) KS&SS Rules interpretation; G.O. (P) No. 548/2008/H&FWD Rule 8 application; clarificatory letter 24.04.2010 validity; absorption with retained seniority vs fresh joining date reckoning; HC reversed Single Judge's pro-absorbed employees order; SC upheld Single Judge on seniority from initial DHS appointment date; policy intent to eliminate dual control supports past service retention.
legal_provisions_cited: Kerala State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1958 Rule 27(a), Rule 27(c)
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; impugned High Court judgment set aside; Single Judge's order restored; absorbed employees retain seniority from initial DHS appointment date.
